translations.web: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.
translations.bsb: and those who use the things of this world, as if not dependent on them. For this world in its present form is passing away.
translations.kjv: And they that use this world, as not abusing it: for the fashion of this world passeth away.
